infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lost & Found needs camera access to scan QR stickers on campus belongings and take photos of items.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lost & Found needs photo library access to attach pictures of lost or found belongings.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Lost & Found to scan QR stickers on campus items.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Lost & Found to access your photos to attach item images.
